title: Rock Town River Outfitters Marina

services.name: Bike Tours
services.desc: At Rock Town River Outfitters, we offer a variety of mountain bike rental options for every skill level and at varying sizes. Our location at 4420 River Mountain Road offers Marin full suspension and electric full suspension mountain bikes with easy access to the River Mountain Trail. From our storefront, you can either start at the bottom of the trail system or we offer a half-day or full-day shuttle services so that you can maximize your riding time. If you are interested in taking one of our bikes on other local trails in Little Rock, we can either deliver it to the trailhead for a small fee or, if you have the appropriate rack, you can reserve your time to pick up the bike. 2023 Marin

services.name: Kayak Tours
services.desc: Rock Town River Outfitters prides itself on being Little Rock’s first Arkansas River outfitter and the premier outdoor recreational company. Our rental program allows guests ages 11 and up to hop on the Arkansas River for two hours. We also offer four-hour rentals for our fishing kayaks. If you’re looking for a fun, daytime adventure, reserve one of our kayaks or standup paddleboards today. Want a more intimate experience with insight into why Little Rock is so great? We offer sunset tours! We suit you up with life jackets and light up vests so that you can continue the fun even after the sun goes down. Reserve your spot today and be sure to bring a friend! services.name: Pontoon Boat Tours
services.desc: Rock Town River Outfitters has expanded its services to offer guided pontoon boat tours on the Arkansas River! Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion, hosting a corporate event, or simply looking to have a fantastic time with friends and family, our experienced team is here to make your evening one to remember. Our spacious, 24-foot party barge is outfitted with a premium Bluetooth sound system and adjustable mood lighting to set the tone for any occasion. The pontoon boat will launch from Rock City Yacht Club located at 1726 E. 2nd Street in downtown Little Rock. If over the age of 21, guests can bring alcoholic beverages on board.
